access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: OAuth access token (obtained via authorization flow)

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token (for automatic token renewal)

id_token.title: ID Token
id_token.description: OpenID Connect ID token (contains user and org info)

expires_at.title: Token Expiration
expires_at.description: Unix timestamp when the access token expires

organization_id.title: Organization ID
organization_id.description: OpenAI organization ID (extracted from ID token or manually set)

proxy_id.title: Proxy ID
proxy_id.description: Optional proxy for OAuth and API requests

client_id.title: OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: Custom OAuth client ID (defaults to official Codex CLI client)

redirect_uri.title: Redirect URI
redirect_uri.description: OAuth redirect URI (must match authorization request)
